cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've made you soup. The choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. But take my bread too. I can't swallow yet, and you shouldn't have to ask twice.
